blocks.html: The details of a physical index that a provider holds.

types.name: provider
types.description: The identifier of the provider holding the index.

types.name: document_count
types.description:
The number of documents in the index. The Search Module uses it to spot an
index that lost its data and needs reseeding.

types.name: created_at
types.description: The date the index was created.

types.name: updated_at
types.description: The date the index was last updated.
